name: job-watch
description: Your Slurm batch jobs on the cluster, watched from your own computer over one ssh call a minute: progress, loss and val curves, GPU history and sweeps, drawn as charts in the desktop app.

host.title: ssh host
host.description: The ssh alias of the cluster's login node. It must log in without a prompt (key auth).

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often the cluster is asked about your jobs, in one ssh call.

gpuSeconds.title: GPU refresh (s)
gpuSeconds.description: GPU refresh for the job selected in /jobs, while the pane is open.

historySamples.title: GPU history samples
historySamples.description: GPU readings kept per job for the history chart.

idleMinutes.title: Idle GPU alert (min)
idleMinutes.description: Alert when a GPU of a running job sits at 0% with no process this long.

silentMinutes.title: Silent log alert (min)
silentMinutes.description: Alert when a running job's log has not grown this long.

nearLimitMinutes.title: Near time limit (min)
nearLimitMinutes.description: Alert this long before a job's time limit (at most its last quarter).

staleCkptMinutes.title: Stale checkpoint (min)
staleCkptMinutes.description: Alert when a running job's newest checkpoint is older than this.

pendingMinutes.title: Long pending (min)
pendingMinutes.description: Alert when a job has been pending this long.
